title: Ken Griffin sells Park Avenue duplex for $58 million
summary_full: Ken Griffin sold his duplex apartment at 740 Park Avenue for $58 million to Woody Johnson. The deal, which was completed off-market, reflects a significant appreciation in value for Griffin since his purchase. Woody Johnson’s new acquisition adds to his existing real estate portfolio, which includes properties in New Jersey and Palm Beach.
